description.describe_ch: An interdisciplinary course in personal development that introduces basic concepts and practical skills for improving and enhancing life during college and beyond. The course includes how to succeed in college, manage one's finances, plan one's career, manage stress, and increase overall contribution to your community, country and world as a global citizen.
